name: Lair Of The Leviathan
storyline:
Journey to the vast expanse of the western frontier. The people here are used to adventurers from near and afar. Would-be heroes traveling through their small cottages and acting like the whole world owes them. Far from the capital, the lands are wild and untamed. Rogue duchies, rival kings and warlords fight amongst themselves, far from the Empire’s mighty armies. While it is a land of spectacular, rugged beauty, something dangerous stirs beneath the surface. War in the north remains a constant threat, while lawless bandits and terrifying monsters roam from crag to peak, just waiting for nightfall to raid the walls of a peaceful town.

What sounds rather unwelcoming is the perfect place for a brave soul like you. Form a group of hearty adventurers, ready to take on this world and maybe even do a little good (or deprive the unsuspecting peasant of their worldly goods, should the opportunity arise!). There are plenty of people, from townsfolk to traveling merchants, who might require a helping hand in exchange for a good coin or a key that points to the next big adventure.

Choose your path, explore the world by your own rules. Don’t let the main story dictate your path - feel free to write your own adventure. Just like in the classics of this Genre. But keep in mind that some dungeons may present dangerous challenges for your party, which you aren’t yet equipped to handle...
summary: Journey through a large open world with a party of heroes exploring dungeons, villages and mysteries. Manage an adventuring party of heroes and choose the way their stories evolve as they journey through a non linear epic adventure towards the ultimate Lair of the Leviathan.
